content.short: Warpcast is the flagship decentralized social networking client for the Farcaster protocol on Ethereum Layer 2.
content.description: Warpcast is the premier decentralized social media application built natively on the Farcaster protocol, designed to provide a professional-grade user experience within a transparent and permissionless framework. While it functions similarly to traditional social platforms like X (Twitter), Warpcast operates fully on-chain—primarily on the Optimism network—ensuring that users maintain total sovereignty over their digital identity, content, and social graph. The platform features an intuitive interface that abstracts the technical complexities of blockchain technology for all.
content.meta: Warpcast provides a decentralized social networking client for Farcaster. Discover Warpcast and other Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
